cases.rationale: The existing exact integer-key procedure already covers this textual-versus-numeric ordering error.
Extend the same numeric-key correction to a declared finite decimal input variant while retaining exact whole-number ordering.

Reject inputs outside the declared format rather than silently using lexical fallback.

NaN, infinities, exponent forms and thousands separators remain outside this fixture format.
unsafe_if: Old integer applicability or original spelling is lost.
